name: claude-remote
description: Interactive Claude Code pane for dinotty

scripts.build:windows-launcher: cd native && rustc --edition=2021 --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -C opt-level=s -C strip=symbols -o ../dist/cli-wrapper.exe windows-launcher.rs
scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:ui && npm run set:cli-executable
scripts.build:test-modules: esbuild src/protocol.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/protocol.mjs --platform=neutral && esbuild src/reduce.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/reduce.mjs --platform=neutral && esbuild src/versions.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/versions.mjs --platform=neutral && esbuild src/turn.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/turn.mjs && esbuild src/mcp-permission.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/mcp-permission.mjs
